HARD RULE: never call submit before you have (a) run run_tests on the public examples and seen them pass, and (b) run at least one brute-force comparison with run_python. Hand-checking the samples in your head is not enough: in past failures, solutions submitted after 2 calls with no test run were wrong on the samples or on hidden tests. If your first draft fails a sample, fix it before anything else. Typical slips to check: off-by-one in 1-based vs 0-based indices, modulo applied too late or with negative numbers, forgetting that the start value counts in a sum, treating a functional graph's cycles and trees separately, and wrong handling of the first/last element of a sequence.

6. Keep your budget in mind
